text.body: ॥śrī murukāṣṭakam ॥ siddhibuddhipradaṃ devaṃ subrahmaṇyāgrajaṃ prabhum । somāpratanayaṃ vande vighnarājamaharniśam ॥ 1 mukārastu mukundassyāt rukāro rudravācakaḥ। kakārastu brahmavādī muruko guhavācakaḥ ॥ maruka śrīmatānnatha bhogamokṣapradapramo। devadeva mahāsnena pāhipāhi sadā vibho । 3 murukaṃ muktidaṃ devaṃ munīnāṃ modakaṃ prabhum । mocakaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ mohanāśaṃ sadānumaḥ ॥ 4 murukeṇa mukundena munīnāṃ hārdavāsinā । vallīśena maheśena pālitāssarvadā vayam ॥ murukāya namaḥ prātaḥ murukāya namo niśi । murukāya namaḥ sāyaṃ murukāya namo namaḥ ॥6 murukāsparātsatyāt ṣaṇmukhāt śikhivāhanāt । guhātparaṃ na jāne'haṃ tasvaṃ kimapi sarvadā ।। 7 murakasya maheśasya vallīsenāpateḥ prabhoḥ । cidambara vilāsasya caraṇau sarvadā bhaje ॥ 8 muruke ṣaṇmukhe deve śikhivāhe dviṣaḍbhuje । kṛttikātanaye śambhau sarvadā ramatāṃ manaḥ ॥ 9 murukatyāṣṭakamidaṃ somaśekharayajvamiḥ । saṃstutaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ śāśvataṃ tasya maṅgalam ॥10 ॥ iti śrī murukāṣṭakaṃ samāptam ॥
